description: The public web search repeatedly returned unrelated or historical materials despite period wording. Search result date filters were visibly unreliable; no item in these responses established a public assembly beginning in this month.
required_followup: Continue with additional local and regional outlet discovery and date verification; treat the current search pass as a documented partial open-web first pass, not a no-event finding.

description: Searches targeted women’s rights, labor/teachers and selected major/provincial locations but did not systematically cover every Afghan province, occupation, community source or local outlet.
required_followup: Extend province-by-province and sector-specific source discovery, including contemporary local outlets and civic/union reporting where accessible.

description: Some Dari and Pashto search terms were used, but no independent translation or systematic review of Pashto/Dari local archives was completed; translated search results may omit or misdate gatherings.
required_followup: Run native-language searches with qualified language review and inspect contemporary local-language reporting when accessible.

description: No in-period event was established from the captured results. Month-boundary continuation remains open. Afghanistan March 2025 report retains undated/search-only women’s gathering leads, including a held TOLOnews Facebook Faryab lead (AFG202503_S001); its date and ownership cannot be inferred, and the existing hold must not be treated as permission to open it or a copy.
required_followup: Resolve dates and start-month ownership from permitted evidence; keep the March Faryab lead held under its existing source-scope restriction unless the owner resolves the restriction.

description: The searches do not provide LexisNexis-equivalent newspaper coverage. Search-only excerpts were not coded as facts; no source body was requested and no event-level source card qualified for this monthly file.
required_followup: Use accessible independent contemporary sources and document unresolved archives, body access and coverage limits. Do not infer absence from empty in-scope leads.

description: The exact complete search-tool input argument object was not persisted before the invocations. Captured search logs preserve the submitted query descriptions and responses, but do not establish a pre-call request manifest; response_length and any unexposed invocation metadata remain unavailable. Call-level local start/response clocks were not recorded, so elapsed search, reading, wait, repair and closure intervals are unknown.
required_followup: For later invocations, save the full exact argument object before the call and record local UTC start/response clocks immediately around it; retain these prior provenance gaps as unknown.
